newsitem.title: CHINA: China punishes 12 banks, brokerages in share case.
newsitem.headline: China punishes 12 banks, brokerages in share case.

text.p: The China Securities Regulatory Commission has punished and fined 12 bank branches and brokerages for illegally bidding for shares on credit, the China Securities newspaper reported on Saturday.

The CRSC listed seven other banks, brokerages and financial institutions which it said had illlegally bid for shares in Qinghai Mingjiao and two others which it said had illegally bid for shares in Jiangsu Supu.

Such actions contravened China's securities regulations, seriously interfered with the normal order of the securities market and destroyed the principles of fairness and equality in the market, the CSRC said.
Accordingly, the CRSC had imposed warnings and fines but did not give details of the punishment imposed on each firm, the newspaper said.
The official press said on Friday the authorities had disciplined two state banks for illegally lending money to securities firms.

A rare front-page commentary in the People's Daily newspaper said the punishment demonstrated the determination of the state to further strengthen the supervision and management of the banking and securities markets.
